subject: S13 done: notes, highlights, notebooks, PDF export, ink_ocr (local evidence; first green CI run pending)
body:
S13 done (local evidence; no green CI run yet, the lead's rule is not to wait). Head of my work: 745f1f6f on claude/naadi-shared.

COMMITS (all on claude/naadi-shared): 469e791 feature; 9c7a8b6, aa42125 e2e fixes; 57ff7dad, d8fcca96 lazy NoteEditor + declarative quote; 745f1f6f reader renders content first, highlight engine + page-notes panel load after first paint.

WHAT WAS BUILT
- Backend: migration 0017 (renumbered from my claimed 0015 because seg12b's 0016 landed first; chain 0014>0016>0017, one head), notes/notebooks API (API-only writes, RLS select-only, question anchors 403 before a graded attempt), body_text + S07 embeddings (note, ink), ink_ocr graph (Pillow tiles, one vision call per tile via llm.py, idle sweep + nightly deferred retry, per-user cap, opt-out profiles.settings.handwriting_search default on), POST /api/ink/convert, public-config storage_buckets.user_uploads.
- Web: selection toolbar (Key fact / Formula / My mistake, Note, Card; Ask hidden until S14), highlight anchoring + Detached, page-notes panel (Type/Write/Both), Notes page (filters, search, Export PDF), notebooks with 5 papers, Excalidraw 0.18.1 whiteboards (self-hosted assets), offline queues (Dexie), PDF export with ink (pdf-lib 1.17.1 + fontkit), Search Notes + Handwriting groups.

LOCAL RESULTS
- vitest 737; unit pytest (-m "not live and not db") 1703 passed; db suite 416 passed (fresh stack, after the 0017 rebase); lint, typecheck, contracts drift, requirements drift clean.
- Smoke set (notes + notebooks specs, webkit ipad portrait/landscape, webkit phone-390, chromium laptop-1440) 44/44, --retries=0, twice in a row (before the later reader/e2e changes).
- After the lazy-loading changes: notes.spec 24/24 over webkit ipad portrait/landscape/phone-390, chromium laptop-1440/ipad-portrait, firefox laptop-1440, including :426 (prod CSP, quote via the selection toolbar). learn.spec + qbank.spec on webkit ipad landscape + chromium laptop: 39 passed, 1 failed (qbank.spec:187 'a pool failure' on webkit ipad landscape: Builder page, no notes code; not investigated further).
- Reader chunk: static closure has no TipTap/ProseMirror; highlight engine and page-notes panel are lazy chunks loaded after first paint. NOT measured with Lighthouse (seg22 owns that run).

CI: run https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44016365966 (469e791): lint/typecheck/unit/drift/build + db jobs green; the 3 e2e jobs were red. Failures were all mine or test-side and are fixed in later commits: firefox notebooks.spec font-abort-on-navigation (16 cases), chromium notes.spec:181 wrapped-highlight tap, webkit config.spec nav duplicate now that Notes is built in. chromium search.spec:239 and today.spec:367 (prod HTTPS 'ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES' on an asset) failed in that run and I did not show whether they are mine. No later CI run has been read by me, so I cannot claim the matrix is green.

CHECKLIST (docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md): ui_copy for all strings + REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS + defaults regenerated; server responses structured (error codes, no sentences); one lime CTA per view (limeCount asserted in notes e2e); no answer/explanation before an attempt (explanation highlights only after answering, 403 tested); RLS/grants in the migration + coverage test + live_check updated; single alembic head; APP_ENV=prod e2e with zero console errors for notes and notebooks; only free models via llm.py, PII scrubbed, bodies never logged; screenshots below.
SCREENSHOTS (on the session machine, not in the repo): /home/user/naadi/.tmp/shots/notes (48 files) and /home/user/naadi/.tmp/shots/notebooks (72 files), each state at iPad portrait, iPad landscape, phone 390 (+ laptop).

DECISIONS / KNOWN GAPS
- Ask is hidden until S14 extends the assistant ask registry (apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts is S14's).
- 'Convert to text' is not on notebook pages: the ink engine has no replace-lasso-with-text hook (needs a packages/ink change). POST /api/ink/convert exists and is tested; no dead button is shown.
- The real vision model was never called (all OCR tests mock the gateway). A layer needing more than max_tiles tiles is read top-down only.
- config PUT cap for ui_copy raised 64 KB -> 256 KB (ui_copy is ~70 KB now).
- config.spec.ts (S03's) now uses the pathway flag/nav instead of notes, since Notes is built in.
- Whiteboard images and note images appear once public-config serves storage_buckets.user_uploads (added in this work).
